_comment: The employment directory the ownership ladder's fourth rung consults.
Its job is not to find an owner — the rungs above do that — but to decide
whether the owner they found still works here. An endpoint attributed to
somebody who left is worse than one attributed to nobody: it reads as
resolved on every report while the escalation goes to an address no one
martin.weiss is the case that matters. He is the last author of the
legacy-balance handler, which is the endpoint this estate retires, and he
has departed with no successor. The ladder must keep him on the record as
the only lead anyone has, drop confidence to 0.5x, set reachable false, and
name the department head — rather than blanking the owner and losing the
lead, or leaving him looking contactable.
